GOOD TO KNOW

A little clarity.

Questions about the collection, the files and what comes next.

Are the paid products available yet?

Not yet. The property guide is complete for review, and checkout is being prepared. The Financial Clarity Kit and Inner Compass journal are in development. Paid orders are not currently accepted.

How can I get the free planner?

Download the two-page PDF from its product page. No account or email address is needed.

Are these physical products?

No. VEXLUME creates digital resources. The free planner and property guide are PDF files that you can view or print. No physical item is shipped.

Can I print the planner on A4?

Yes. Its pages are US Letter size; choose Fit to page in your print settings for A4. Preview the margins before printing.

Can I edit the PDFs?

The current PDFs are printable resources, not fillable forms. You can annotate them in a compatible PDF reader. The planned budgeting workbook will be editable.

Which currency are the prices in?

The displayed paid-product prices are planned launch prices in US dollars. Checkout pricing, taxes and any currency conversion will be confirmed before paid sales begin.

Can I share or resell a download?

The free planner is for personal use. Please share its product-page link rather than redistributing the file. Paid-product license options will be finalized before sales begin.

Can I use these with clients?

A professional-use license has not yet been offered. Do not redistribute files or include them in paid client packages without written permission.

Will there be French versions?

The current development version is in English. French-language requirements and product localization must be resolved before commercial launch from Quebec.
